blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala continues her campaign at the Ningbo Open facing a tough test against sixth seed Diana Shnaider on Wednesday. Eala and Shnaider meet for the first time with a quarterfinal spot in the WTA 500 event at stake. Filipino World No. 20 returned to her winning ways on Monday night after sweeping Diane Parry of France, 6-3, 6-1, in the round of 32.
